name: Bee Hotel Utils
description: Dependency-free utility services shared by all Bee Hotel modules: date normalisation, unit/node helpers, currency/commerce helpers.
project_description: Bee Hotel Utils is the foundation submodule of the Bee Hotel suite. It deliberately has no dependencies inside bee_hotel and provides four stateless helper services consumed by every other Bee Hotel module: Dates (search-form date normalisation, Easter/season helpers, day arrays), BeeHotel (currency codes, product/attribute helpers), BeeHotelUnit (is-this-a-bee-hotel-unit checks, occupancy, availability lookups, base tables) and BeeHotelCommerce (current store/currency helpers).
